title: John Malalas, Chronographia, Books I–XIII; «Хронография» Иоанна Малалы, кн. I–XIII
author: John Malalas
size: Books I–XIII est. 60–70k words (about 60% of the work)
edition: Dindorf, CSHB 1831 (public domain). Thurn, CFHB 35 (2000; in copyright)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia: Russian exists for books XIV–XVIII (Samutkina 2000/2003; Chekalova 2001). For I–XIII only excerpts of II and V (Averintsev 1987; Freiberg 1968) and VIII (Talakh 2013)
en_evidence: Jeffreys, Jeffreys, Scott et al., Byzantina Australiensia 4 (1986), listed on ru.wikipedia
other_translations: Old Slavonic (Istrin). German translation (Thurn–Meier 2009) and a French project not re-verified in this session
value: Covers mythography, Troy (after Dictys), Persians, Alexander and the Seleucids, the foundation of Antioch and the Roman emperors. Central to the reception of antiquity, the Alexander tradition and Slavonic chronography, so a strong match for the editor's specialism.
ai_feasibility: High: simple Greek. Text reconstruction needs Slavonic and Excerpta parallels; Dindorf's text is outdated and Thurn's is in copyright
pilot_unit: Book VIII (Alexander, Diadochi, Seleucus, Antioch), est. 5–6k words
